input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Customer anywhere in the Agreement. Clause 12.3 expressly preserves Customer's freedom to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service and to engage any supplier, and confirms Customer has made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment; clause 2.1 adds that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that declining to sign a further Order Form is not a breach or shortfall. The only exclusivity-type restraint is clause 12.4, which binds Vendor not to market a directly competing analytics service — a restriction that benefits Customer and is therefore not flagged. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
